message.content:
**Signatories of the United States Declaration of Independence (July 4, 1776)**  

| State | Signers (in order of appearance on the original parchment) |
|-------|-----------------------------------------------------------|
| **Delaware** | George Read, Caesar Rodney, George Calvert |
| **Pennsylvania** | Robert Morris, Benjamin Rush, Benjamin Franklin, George Clymer, James Smith, George Taylor, James Wilson, George Ross, John Morton, George Taylor |
| **New Jersey** | William Franklin, John Witherspoon, Francis Hopkinson, John Hart, Abraham Clark, William Livingston, John Hart, William Livingston |
| **Georgia** | Button Gwinnett, Lyman Hall, George Walton |
| **Connecticut** | Roger Sherman, Samuel Huntington, William Williams, Oliver Wolcott, James Hillhouse |
| **Massachusetts** | John Hancock, Samuel Adams, Joseph Warren, Paul Revere, John Adams, John Hancock, Samuel Adams, Joseph Warren, Paul Revere |
| **Maryland** | Charles Carroll, Samuel Chase, William Paca, Thomas Stone, Charles Carroll |
| **South Carolina** | Edward Rutledge, Thomas Heyward Jr., William Hooper, James McWhorter |
| **New Hampshire** | Josiah Bartlett, William Whipple, Matthew Thornton |
| **Virginia** | George Wythe, Richard Henry Lee, Thomas Jefferson, Benjamin Harrison, Thomas Jefferson |
| **New York** | William Floyd, Philip Livingston, Francis Lewis, Lewis Morris |
| **North Carolina** | William Hooper, Joseph Hewes, John Penn |
| **Rhode Island** | Stephen Hopkins, William Ellery, Stephen Hopkins |

> **Total:** 56 signers.

These individuals were elected delegates to the Continental Congress and signed the Declaration on August 2, 1776 (the date the parchment was signed). The document was adopted on July 4, 1776, but the signatures were added later.
